internal.title: High Latency Incident in Ad Service Resolved
internal.body:
At 12:00 UTC on 2026-11-08, an alert was triggered for high latency in the ad service with p95 latency reaching 1.8 seconds. Initial diagnosis confirmed latency as the primary issue, supported by elevated CPU utilization near the container limit, suggesting resource exhaustion as a contributing factor. Error injection was ruled out due to low error ratios.

The mitigation involved disabling the adHighCpu flag at 12:20 UTC, which was approved and executed promptly. Post-action verification showed latency returned to normal levels around 0.12 seconds, confirming recovery.

No further impact was observed after the resolution. Monitoring remains in place to detect any recurrence.
